## Empowering Appalachia Through Artificial&nbsp;Intelligence


The Appalachian A.I. Corps is an initiative dedicated to empowering Appalachian communities to harness artificial intelligence technologies to support their region, communities, and families.


We believe that the power of AI should be accessible to all. Through education, collaboration, and practical application, we're building a future where Appalachian communities lead in the intelligent use of technology.

<script>
// If user is already logged in or in guest mode, make the button go directly to modules
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var isGuest = sessionStorage.getItem('guestMode') === 'true';
  if (isGuest) {
    var btn = document.querySelector('a.btn[href="choose-role.html"]');
    if (btn) btn.href = 'modules.html';
    return;
  }

  // Check Supabase session
  function checkAndUpdateBtn() {
    if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
      setTimeout(checkAndUpdateBtn, 200);
      return;
    }
    _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
      if (result.data.session) {
        var btn = document.querySelector('a.btn[href="choose-role.html"]');
        if (btn) btn.href = 'modules.html';
      }
    });
  }
  checkAndUpdateBtn();
});
</script>
